links.comparator_used: Direct processing of the original Korean notes and exam questions by the Korean-adapted open-source LLM (openbuddy-mistral-7b-v13.1)
links.outcome: Top-1 diagnostic accuracy, clue hallucination rate and clue clinical relevance on psychiatric notes, and licensing exam performance
links.effect: Top-1 accuracy 74.5% (English) vs 59% (Korean), P<.001; top-2 accuracy 89.5% vs 90%, P=.56. Hallucinated clues 13.4% vs 30.2%. Diagnostically relevant clues 42.8% vs 34.2%. Licensing exam 46.1% (53/115) vs 32.2% (37/115) correct, with English better in 7 of 11 diagnostic categories.
links.quote: The model showed significantly higher top-1 diagnostic accuracy with English input (74.5% vs 59%; P<.001), while top-2 accuracy was comparable (89.5% vs 90%; P=.56).

design_hint: translating non-English notes to English before LLM processing
